dimensions.name: Primary financial service
dimensions.definition: The main financial function that the DeFi application provides to its users.
dimensions.application_rule: Choose the service through which users mainly transact with the application, following this precedence when several services apply: stablecoin issuance and insurance first if the application's core user action is issuing a stablecoin or buying cover; then derivatives and synthetic assets; then prediction markets; then lending and borrowing; then exchange and trading; then asset management and funds; then data and analytics. Infrastructure and access applies to blockchains, wallets, bridges and development tools even when they host financial services; the other values apply to applications that offer the service itself.

characteristics.name: Exchange and trading
characteristics.definition: Users trade crypto-assets with each other or against liquidity pools.

characteristics.name: Lending and borrowing
characteristics.definition: Users supply assets for interest or borrow against collateral.

characteristics.name: Stablecoin issuance
characteristics.definition: The application issues or manages a stablecoin pegged to a currency.

characteristics.name: Insurance
characteristics.definition: The application provides cover or claims payouts against risks.

characteristics.name: Derivatives and synthetic assets
characteristics.definition: The application creates or trades derivatives or assets that track other assets.

characteristics.name: Asset management and funds
characteristics.definition: The application pools, tokenizes or manages investment funds or baskets of assets.

characteristics.name: Prediction markets
characteristics.definition: Users trade shares on the outcomes of events.

characteristics.name: Data and analytics
characteristics.definition: The application presents financial data about DeFi protocols.

characteristics.name: Infrastructure and access
characteristics.definition: Blockchains, wallets, bridges and development tools that enable DeFi without themselves providing a financial service.

dimensions.name: Value capture mechanism
dimensions.definition: The main way in which the provider of the DeFi application captures value.
dimensions.application_rule: Choose the revenue or incentive mechanism that is central to the application. Native token value applies only when the native token is central to revenue or incentives.

characteristics.name: Fees on transactions
characteristics.definition: The provider or liquidity providers earn fees charged on transactions.

characteristics.name: Native token value capture
characteristics.definition: Value is captured through a native token used for governance, rewards, collateral or utility.

characteristics.name: No direct value capture
characteristics.definition: The object is an infrastructure or information service without its own revenue mechanism.

dimensions.name: Governance model
dimensions.definition: Who makes the operational and protocol decisions of the DeFi application.
dimensions.application_rule: Choose the body that decides protocol parameters or operations, following this precedence: token-holder governance first when governance token holders vote, even if no central operator exists; then company operation when a company or exchange operates the application or its blockchain; then validator-run network when network validators keep the network running and decide its operation; then autonomous without central operator when no central party runs the application and it operates through smart contracts.

characteristics.name: Token-holder governance
characteristics.definition: Holders of a governance or native token vote on protocol decisions.

characteristics.name: Validator-run network
characteristics.definition: Network validators keep the network running and decide its operation.

characteristics.name: Company operation
characteristics.definition: A company or exchange operates the application or its blockchain.

characteristics.name: Autonomous without central operator
characteristics.definition: No central party runs the application; it operates through smart contracts.

dimensions.name: Asset custody model
dimensions.definition: Where the assets of users are held while the DeFi application processes them.
dimensions.application_rule: Choose where user assets are held. Self-custody applies when users keep their private keys; assets held in smart contracts apply when deposits are locked in protocol contracts.

characteristics.name: Self-custody by users
characteristics.definition: Users keep their own private keys and control their assets.

characteristics.name: Assets held in smart contracts
characteristics.definition: Deposited assets are locked in and managed by smart contracts.

characteristics.name: Assets held by a company
characteristics.definition: A company or platform holds the assets of users.

characteristics.name: No assets held
characteristics.definition: The object is an information or infrastructure service that does not hold user assets.

dimensions.name: Underlying consensus
dimensions.definition: The consensus mechanism of the blockchain on which the application runs.
dimensions.application_rule: Choose the consensus of the blockchain that validates the transactions of the object. Use the negation value when the object has no own blockchain and runs on an existing public chain.

characteristics.name: Proof-of-work
characteristics.definition: Transactions are validated through proof-of-work consensus.

characteristics.name: Proof-of-stake
characteristics.definition: Transactions are validated through proof-of-stake consensus.

characteristics.name: Other consensus (aBFT or DAG)
characteristics.definition: Transactions are validated through a non-standard mechanism such as aBFT or a directed acyclic graph.

characteristics.name: No own blockchain
characteristics.definition: The application runs on an existing public blockchain and has no consensus of its own.

dimensions.name: Blockchain deployment layer
dimensions.definition: The layer of the blockchain architecture on which the application is deployed.
dimensions.application_rule: Choose the chain on which the core smart contracts of the object run. Ethereum mainnet is the Ethereum base layer; layer-2 applies to networks built on Ethereum; own layer-1 applies when the object is its own blockchain.

characteristics.name: Ethereum mainnet
characteristics.definition: The application runs on the Ethereum public blockchain.

characteristics.name: Layer-2 on Ethereum
characteristics.definition: The application runs on a scaling network built on Ethereum.

characteristics.name: Own layer-1 blockchain
characteristics.definition: The object is its own layer-1 blockchain.

characteristics.name: Other existing public blockchain
characteristics.definition: The application runs on a public blockchain other than Ethereum.

characteristics.name: No blockchain deployment
characteristics.definition: The service is run off-chain by a company.

dimensions.name: Trading mechanism
dimensions.definition: How the application matches trades between users.
dimensions.application_rule: Choose the mechanism used to price or match trades. Use the negation value when the application does not trade assets.

characteristics.name: Automated market maker
characteristics.definition: Trades are priced by liquidity pools rather than order books.

characteristics.name: On-chain order book
characteristics.definition: Orders are placed and matched through an order book on the blockchain.

characteristics.name: Off-chain matching with on-chain settlement
characteristics.definition: Orders are matched off-chain while trades are settled on-chain.

characteristics.name: No trading mechanism
characteristics.definition: The application does not trade assets between users.

dimensions.name: Collateral backing
dimensions.definition: How the reserves or assets that back a stablecoin are constituted.
dimensions.application_rule: For a stablecoin, choose the main type of asset that backs it. Choose 'Not fully backed by collateral' when its collateral is less than its value in circulation. Choose 'Not a stablecoin' for objects that do not issue a stablecoin.

characteristics.name: Off-chain reserves
characteristics.definition: The stablecoin is backed by reserves held outside the blockchain, such as fiat currency.

characteristics.name: On-chain crypto assets
characteristics.definition: The stablecoin is backed by crypto-assets locked on the blockchain.

characteristics.name: Commodity-based
characteristics.definition: The stablecoin is backed by commodities.

characteristics.name: Not fully backed by collateral
characteristics.definition: The stablecoin is not fully backed by collateral.

characteristics.name: Not a stablecoin
characteristics.definition: The object does not issue or manage a stablecoin, so no backing applies.

dimensions.name: Collateralization
dimensions.definition: Whether a loan is secured by collateral relative to the loan value.
dimensions.application_rule: For a lending object, choose the collateral level of the loan offered as the main lending option. Choose 'No loan' for objects that do not grant loans.

characteristics.name: Overcollateralized
characteristics.definition: The collateral exceeds the loan value, so liquidation occurs if the collateral-to-loan ratio falls under the threshold.

characteristics.name: Undercollateralized
characteristics.definition: The collateral is less than the loan value.

characteristics.name: Zero collateral
characteristics.definition: The loan requires no collateral.

characteristics.name: No loan
characteristics.definition: The object does not grant loans, so no collateralization applies.

dimensions.name: Rate variability over time
dimensions.definition: Whether the interest rate changes dynamically over time or is fixed when the loan is taken or the liquidity is provided.
dimensions.application_rule: For an object that charges or pays interest, choose whether the rate changes with the current utilization of the pool (dynamic) or is fixed at the time of the loan or deposit (fixed). Choose 'No interest rate' for objects that charge or pay no interest.

characteristics.name: Dynamic rate
characteristics.definition: The rate can change over time, for example based on the updated utilization.

characteristics.name: Fixed rate
characteristics.definition: The rate is fixed based on the rate at the time the loan was taken or the liquidity was provided.

characteristics.name: No interest rate
characteristics.definition: The object charges or pays no interest on loans or deposits.
